Iunno about this one. I really dig the idea of the UIU investigating an exploding whale but this just,,,doesn't really do anything fun with it? It ends up being very dry and pretty repetitive since like half the tabs just rehash the same info.

Okay well, now I've said this, it feels more clearly like this has unfortunately wandered into downvote territory for me :(

+ minor things
– hide block

UIU agents in the Three Portlands area were dispatched to Florence under request of the Fish and Wildlife Service Anomalous Detachment, as the higher-ups suspected the event was paranatural and beyond the capabilities of their staff.

I guess I'm not exactly clear on why the Fish and Wildlife Service Anomalous Detachment can't handle an anomalous thing here?

The agents used one stick of dynamite, several fake cases of dynamite, and a detonator to ignite the fluid within the whale, under the guise of government officials.

…UIU agents are government officials.

item.content:encoded:
I liked the article, and I upvoted it, but I believe that the way UIU is portrayed is… bad. Under no circumstances would a unit such as the UIU be so ill-funded that they would be unable to amnesticize the population in an emergency, or prevent the media from airing a broadcast of an anomalous event. I mean, what if the situation was not a whale, but something far more dangerous?
And really, the part where agents "attempt to cordon off the area but are ignored"… How could that possibly happen? Imagine a paramilitary unit such as the UIU being ignored by the civilians during an emergency. That's problematic, at best.
